item.title: DroneArt Show: Harry Potter at Constellation Field
item.description:
Friday, August 7, 2026 at 9 PM

Location: Constellation Field, 1 Stadium Dr, Sugar Land, TX, 77498, United States

DroneArt Show returns to Houston with an official Harry Potter light show in the sky at Constellation Field in Sugar Land. The show promises to be an unforgettable open-air spectacle as 1,200 illuminated drones recreate favorite characters and beloved moments from the Harry Potter films. As night falls, hundreds of synchronized illuminated drones take off and create shapes in the sky, moving in time with John Williams’ movie score played live in a 65-minute performance. Inspired by the Wizarding World, the show ensures every guest takes part in the experience with exclusive LED wristbands. The open air setting will have food and drink for sale. Plus—whether you’re sorted into houses Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin—costumes and Wizarding World attire are highly encouraged. Admission Tickets start at $48; $28 for ages 3 to 11.
